name: Test of Endurance
summary: In Thousand Needles, challengers face the second rite in Dorn Plainstalker's spiritual trials. After proving their courage of spirit, they enter Roguefeather Den to test their physical endurance and draw out its fierce leader, Grenka Bloodscreech.

sections.title: Testing the Body
sections.body: At the Weathered Nook, Dorn Plainstalker prepares young warriors for a wider, harsher world. This trial tests the body's strength. Dorn believes readiness calls for spiritual devotion, mental discipline, and the stamina to endure sustained brutality.

sections.title: Incursion into Roguefeather Den
sections.body: Roguefeather Den lies within Screeching Canyon, west of Freewind Post. Hostile harpies fill the cavern, making it perilous to wander in alone. Challengers fight deep into the roost and vandalize the harpies' gathered provisions. Then they endure the flock's fierce retaliation until its matriarch, Grenka Bloodscreech, enters the fight.

faq.q: Who gives the Test of Endurance?
faq.answer: Dorn Plainstalker, an elder tauren, gives the Test of Endurance from the Weathered Nook in Thousand Needles' canyon bluffs.
Roguefeather Den lies high along Thousand Needles' southern canyon walls, west of Freewind Post. A winding path through Screeching Canyon climbs to the ramp leading to the cave entrance.

faq.q: How do you summon Grenka Bloodscreech?
faq.answer: You draw Grenka Bloodscreech out by fighting to Roguefeather Den's deepest chambers and vandalizing the harpies' stored food and supplies. She appears to defend her roost.

faq.q: What comes after the Test of Endurance?
faq.answer: When you return Grenka's severed claw to Dorn Plainstalker, he accepts it as proof of your physical stamina and sends you to the Test of Strength.

faq.q: Why does Dorn test adventurers who aren't tauren?
faq.answer: Dorn believes his calling is to mentor all Horde youth, whatever their race or tribe. He sees untested pride as a death sentence in the wider world and insists every warrior prove readiness in body, mind, and spirit.

faq.q: What was the trial before this one?
faq.answer: The Test of Faith comes before the Test of Endurance. In that perilous leap of devotion, Dorn tests whether a challenger's spirit will falter in the face of fear.

angles.text: As a tauren, you can see Dorn Plainstalker's trials as rites of passage. They test whether your physical stamina matches the Earth Mother's spiritual guidance.
Dorn offers these challenges to every Horde race. He believes young warriors from every tribe must be tempered by hardship before facing Kalimdor's perils.
